title: FM
description: In this exercise, various FM patches were created using Ableton's Operator instrument, exploring different modulation indices and frequency ratios to achieve a range of timbres and textures for various instruments. The standard drums, lead, pad, and pluck were made alongside some additional fun stuff.

audio.label: Mix
audio.desc: A short snippet was created using the instruments created in this project. A bit overly hectic and cluttered, but maybe that's what my intention was... (it wasn't).

audio.label: Lead
audio.desc: Lead from the mix isolated. A aggressive and percussive voicing was achieved with velocity variation.

audio.label: Bass
audio.desc: Bass from the mix isolated. I believe I wrote this tune in Phyrgian after drawing up the bass part if memory serves correct.

audio.label: Layered Pad
audio.desc: Pad from the mix isolated. A constrasting pad composed of a swelling pad with a mallet strike on the attack.

audio.label: Bells
audio.desc: You can't do FM without creating bells. A sample I created, not quite suited for the mix above.

audio.label: Aux Percussion
audio.desc: Some additional percussion sounds I created with FM.
